descriptions.base: Tokens, paper stocks, ink sets, mark utilities, the appearance runtime, PatinaDefs, SeedScope and the core of the ink engine. Every other item builds on it; make src/patina/styles/patina.css your Tailwind entry.
descriptions.print: Print, a seeded riso illustration, with the print() function and all fifteen motifs.
descriptions.glyph: Glyph: sixteen hand-drawn signs in currentColor.
descriptions.highlight: Highlight: a marker stroke behind a phrase that matters.
descriptions.hand-underline: HandUnderline: two loose strokes under a heading or term.
descriptions.hand-marks: Circle, Strike and Bracket: seeded drawings that hug their content, with no measuring.
descriptions.paper-marks: SketchFrame, Wash, Tape and RoughRule: marks that sit on the paper, varied by their seed.
descriptions.notes: MarginNote and Annotation: handwritten asides with drawn arrows.
descriptions.stamp: Stamp: a rubber-stamp label, outline or solid.
descriptions.paper: Paper: a sheet with a seeded edge (deckle, torn, perforated, pinked), dog-ear, tilt and wear that follows the patina level.
descriptions.chart: Chart: shadcn's Recharts chart with series in the ink set's drums, hatch fills per series, and drawn bars, curves and slices that keep every data point exact.
descriptions.use-highlighted-code: useHighlightedCode: lazy Shiki highlighting with a theme drawn from Patina's text inks, for CodeBlock.
descriptions.typography: Typography: a prose container for long-form text, with a kicker and an optional drop cap.
